text:
ryan: quick Q  I'm flying to Barcelona for a conference. I'm planning to ship a box of demo kits and T-shirts ahead using a courier (UPS) and also want to check an extra bag with hardware. Can the company reimburse shipping and checked-bag fees?
aj: short answer: yes, shipping conference materials and checked baggage for business equipment are reimbursable with pre-approval. must follow a couple steps.
ryan: what steps? the courier invoice will be to my personal card for pickup.
nina: steps: 1) add shipping line in Travel Request and get manager sign-off before shipping; 2) upload courier invoice to Expensify and select "Business Shipping"; 3) if paid personally, set reimbursement to Actuals and attach proof of payment.
ryan: ok. any limits or customs notes for international shipping? the box value ~€1,200.
aj: for international shipments, include commercial invoice showing contents and value. Finance needs HS codes if over threshold and will handle import duties if pre-approved. For high-value kit, we prefer corporate shipping account to keep paperwork clean.
nina: if you paid duties or VAT on arrival, upload the VAT receipt and courier manifest. Finance will reimburse duties if they are business-related and pre-cleared. If VAT is reclaimable, we'll process net reimbursement per policy.
ryan: what about checked baggage fees for extra hardware? I booked on personal fare because portal had no extra baggage option.
aj: checked bag fees are reimbursable if it's for business equipment and manager pre-approved. attach boarding pass, bag tag photo, and receipt showing fee. If you shipped same items and also checked bag, explain both to avoid duplicate reimburse.
nina: practical tip: take photos of the hardware and serial numbers before shipping/checking. helps Finance if items lost or customs queries.
ryan: courier charged insurance fee and weekend pickup surcharge. reimbursable?
aj: insurance for declared value is reimbursable for business equipment. surcharges (weekend, residential pickup) are reimbursable if necessary; include note why (e.g., only available pickup slot). Finance will review reasonableness.
nina: small nuance  if you used a personal vendor discount or promo code, reimburse the actual paid amount. if the company shipping account would have been cheaper, Finance may ask why portal wasn't used.
nina: also tag Travel Request ID in expense comment so travel team can link tracking numbers.
ryan: and if the courier invoice is in EUR and my card charged in USD, which amount gets reimbursed?
nina: reimburse the USD charge shown on your card statement. attach the card statement line with the charge. For large amounts Finance may convert using payment date rate if necessary.
ryan: how fast are reimbursements for shipping? need to pay vendor quickly.
nina: expedite option: mark expense as "Rush" in Expensify and get manager quick-approve. Finance processes rush reimbursements within 3 business days. regular reimbursements follow payroll cycle otherwise.
nina: travel-bot reminder: "Pre-approval required for international shipments > $500 and checked baggage fees for equipment. Add tracking number to Travel Request."
ryan: perfect. i'll add Travel Req 10021, ship via corporate account if travel can provision it, otherwise i'll pay and attach receipts. thanks! :slightly_smiling_face:
